articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
articles.description: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

articles.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
articles.description: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
articles.description: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

articles.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
articles.description: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.description: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
articles.description: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

articles.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
articles.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

articles.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
articles.description: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

articles.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
articles.description: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.

articles.title: Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave Is Surging: Here’s What It Means for the AI Boom
articles.description: CoreWeave's 168% revenue jump sent its shares soaring and lifted Nvidia and other AI stocks. Strong demand is reassuring investors, but the cost of building it remains enormous.

articles.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
articles.description: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.

articles.title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
articles.description: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

articles.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
articles.description: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

articles.title: Bitcoin Short-Term Holders Send $3.6 Billion in BTC to Exchanges at a Loss
articles.description: Recent buyers are moving billions in Bitcoin to exchanges below their purchase prices, while Binance sees sharp inflows from recently moved coins.

articles.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
articles.description: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

articles.title: This New AI Music Model Is Already Better Than Suno—We Put ACE to the Test
articles.description: ACE Music v1 tops the AI music rankings with more natural vocals and stronger song structure. Our tests found impressive results, though niche genres remain a challenge.

articles.title: Tether's Tiny AI Agent Beats Models 2.5 Times Its Size at Controlling Your Phone
articles.description: BotPsy packs 800 million parameters into an AI assistant designed to manage everyday tasks locally, outperforming larger rivals as Tether expands its push into decentralized artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank Goes Live With Crypto Custody After a Five-Year Buildup
articles.description: Deutsche Bank’s custody service now holds Bitcoin, Ethereum and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe.

articles.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
articles.description: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

articles.title: Bitcoin Faces First Back-to-Back Annual Losses in History, But There's a Catch
articles.description: Bitcoin is heading toward its first consecutive losing years, breaking an 18-year pattern. But there's some nuance in the data.

articles.title: What Are Solana Privacy Rings? Inside Helius’ Privacy Protocol for Solana
articles.description: Solana Privacy Rings encrypt balances and transfer amounts without leaving Solana. Here's how they work, and how they compare.

articles.title: A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix
articles.description: Three bugs—spanning denial-of-service and privacy issues rather than coin theft—have all been patched, with the most serious capable of halting a miner’s ability to build new blocks.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
articles.description: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.

articles.title: OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue Sets Launch, Turning to Crypto Companies After Big Tech Opts Out
articles.description: OKXICE will open its tokenized securities venue Nov. 23 with more than 70 assets, led by crypto companies like Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood and Strategy, after 67 companies objected to having their shares listed.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.description: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: Decrypt Becomes First News Publisher to Offer Perps Trading, Powered by Solana's Phoenix
articles.description: The integration brings perpetual futures trading into Decrypt, so readers can trade crypto, stocks and commodities without leaving the news.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
articles.description: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

articles.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
articles.description: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
articles.description: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

articles.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
articles.description: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

articles.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
articles.description: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

articles.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
articles.description: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

articles.title: Morning Minute: What Anthropic’s $1.4 Trillion IPO Means for Crypto
articles.description: Hint: if it plays out similarly to the SpaceX IPO, it means the Bitcoin bottom is very close.

articles.title: Kraken Parent Payward Brings 200 UK and EU Stocks Onchain as xStocks
articles.description: The expansion takes xStocks past 1,500 tokenized assets, though the new UK tokens still can't be bought by investors in the UK.

articles.title: FSB urges Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
articles.description: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

articles.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
articles.description: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
articles.description: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.

articles.title: Bitcoin barely flinches at hot CPI as ETF selling slows
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 11, 2026

articles.title: Nvidia Sheds $430B in Two Days as Jensen Huang Faces Calls to Resign
articles.description: Nvidia's independent directors have hired Wachtell Lipton to investigate its CEO's ties to an alleged Chinese spy, as pressure mounts.

articles.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
articles.description: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.

articles.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
articles.description: Bitcoin held steady near $74,000 as Tuesday's hot inflation figure lifted the odds on a U.S. interest-rate increase to around 90%. ETF outflows extended to a fourth day and liquidations jumped.

articles.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
articles.description: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

articles.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
articles.description: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

articles.title: Avalanche Won Over the NYSE. Now It Has to ‘Capture Value’ for AVAX
articles.description: The New York Stock Exchange will use Avalanche infrastructure, but experts say that won't necessarily boost AVAX's price.

articles.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
articles.description: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
articles.description: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

articles.title: Prisoner Jailed for 8 Years Over $2.7M Crypto Theft Plot Run From His Cell
articles.description: Robert Barr planned to have accomplices force a crypto investor to install remote-access software so he could drain the wallet from prison.

articles.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
articles.description: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

articles.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
articles.description: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

articles.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
articles.description: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

articles.title: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have lost $1.6 billion in November, while stock funds attracted billions of dollars from investors buying the dip.

articles.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
articles.description: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.

articles.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
articles.description: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

articles.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
articles.description: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

articles.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
articles.description: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

articles.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
articles.description: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

articles.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
articles.description: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

articles.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
articles.description: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

articles.title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
articles.description: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

articles.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
articles.description: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
articles.description: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

articles.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
articles.description: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

articles.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
articles.description: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

articles.title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
articles.description: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival’s model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

articles.title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
articles.description: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

articles.title: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
articles.description: The funding, backing a U.S.-incorporated issuer codenamed “Project Faro,” covers five years of operations as traditional lenders move to challenge crypto-native giants Tether and Circle.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
articles.description: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

articles.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
articles.description: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.description: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
articles.description: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

articles.title: Decrypt Money Account Gets Confidential Transfers With Solana Privacy Firm Helius
articles.description: Helius' Solana Privacy Rings will let Decrypt users send funds without broadcasting amounts, as it grows out The Information Exchange.

articles.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70 to $78, Valuing Company at Up to $1.4 Trillion
articles.description: The Claude developer is also lining up $26 billion from Nvidia, Google and other tech giants in a private placement alongside the listing.

articles.title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
articles.description: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

articles.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
articles.description: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.description: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Vitalik Recasts ETH as a Store of Value
articles.description: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

articles.title: Binance Warns of Apple iOS Flaw That Could Expose iPhone Users' Private Keys
articles.description: Apple has not publicly confirmed the "worse_query" bug, which a researcher published days before its latest iOS security update.

articles.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
articles.description: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks with stocks, declines as ETF outflows mount, MARA reduces holdings
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 10, 2026

articles.title: Binance Halts MEXC Transfers as FinCEN Cuts Exchange Off From US Financial System
articles.description: The exchange will reject withdrawals to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after FinCEN tied it to $16 billion in suspicious flows.

articles.title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued by Shareholders Over Alleged Ties to Suspected Chinese Spy
articles.description: A proposed class action claims the chipmaker misled investors about the CEO's alleged affair and the national security risks it posed.

articles.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.description: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
articles.description: A rate hike in December appears totally assured now, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: 'Tough Questions' Ahead: Warren Targets Prediction Markets, Trump Crypto as Banking Chair
articles.description: An aide said Trump family crypto businesses should "preserve their documents" as Warren prepares to take over the Senate Banking Committee.

articles.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
articles.description: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.0 Are Impressive, But Be Prepared to Sell a Kidney to Afford Them
articles.description: Anthropic's latest AI can build complex software and even design physical objects. Users are producing impressive results, and estimated bills large enough to make developers wince.

articles.title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
articles.description: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.

articles.title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
articles.description: Google’s TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.

articles.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
articles.description: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.
